Convert a pondeR Result to a gt Table

Source: R/run_correl.R
as_gt.Rd

Renders pondeR tables as gt tables. Any footnote or p-value legend stored as an attribute ("footnote", "df_footnote", "pvalue_legend") is appended as a source note via tab_source_note.

Usage

as_gt(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'gtsummary'
as_gt(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'data.frame'
as_gt(x, ...)

# Default S3 method
as_gt(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'run_correl'
as_gt(x, format_p = TRUE, ...)

Arguments

x

An object to convert: a run_correl result, a run_diff_summary table from run_diff, a gtsummary table, a data frame/tibble (or anything coercible with as.data.frame()), or a gt_tbl (returned unchanged).

...

Additional arguments forwarded to gt (or to as_gt for gtsummary objects).

format_p

Logical. If TRUE (default), the p-value columns (when present) are displayed via format.pval so that values indistinguishable from zero at double precision render as "< 2.2e-16", matching cor.test's convention. Cosmetic only; does not affect the source x.

Value

A gt_tbl object.

Details

pondeR's generic masks as_gt when both packages are attached, so gtsummary objects are forwarded unchanged to gtsummary::as_gt(). A gt_tbl is returned as is; any other object is coerced with as.data.frame.

References

Iannone R, Cheng J, Schloerke B, et al. (2024). gt: Easily Create Presentation-Ready Display Tables. R package. https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=gt

See also

run_correl, run_diff, run_summarytable

Examples

if (requireNamespace("gt", quietly = TRUE)) {
  as_gt(head(mtcars))
  as_gt(run_correl(mtcars[, 1:4], y = "mpg"))
}
